about_the_game:
Wish Creatures

Wish Creatures is a Turn-Based Monster Taming game where monsters leave your party when they "Level Up".

Explore the world of Monstoria and battle monsters with a party of your own! As you battle, Monsters will automatically leave your team to re-enter the Cosmos as a Star. You can wish on a Star to use their signature battle action, known as a "Star Power"! Balance your ever-changing team with Star Power to take down the most powerful foes!

Features

  • Turn monsters into Stars and wish on them in turn-based battles.

  • Explore a vast province of rustic towns, cityscapes, haunted ruins, magical caves, and more to find Monsters.

  • Recruit Monsters by hearing what they have to say. Inspire them, and they'll join you!

  • An emotional story. Journey with unlikely allies, battle goofy villains, and find the truth about your neighbor's mysterious Monster.

  • Side-activities like the action-based dojo minigame, or the methodical Pulsar Radar that increases the odds of encountering rare Pulsar Monsters.

  • Two difficulty modes: Chill mode for folks who want to freely experiment with Wishes, and Locked-In mode to start battles with no advantages!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Celeron(R) CPU N3150 @ 1.60GHz 1.60 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) HD Graphics ver 20.19.15.4835
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Intel(R) Diplay Audio
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: If in doubt, use the most recent stable DirectX driver.

short_description: Monsters are fallen stars. Raise their Courage through turn-based battle and return them to the Cosmos! Recruit Monsters through conversation, fill the Cosmos, and Wish on the Stars you make in future battles! When it matters most... what will you Wish for?
